text:
DeployBot: Deploy started: tagged release `release/0.24.7-hotpatch` -> service-b on production
DeployBot: Commit `abc1234f` (chore: fix mem leak in connection pool). Change window: emergency hotpatch, outside normal release cycle. Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 20m increments. Docs: https://git.internal/redwood/release/0.24.7-hotpatch :eyes:
Alex Chen: ack. I see canary scheduled for prod-us-east-1 first. I'll watch traces/latency.
Samir: canary started on prod-us-east-1 (5%). Smoke checks running: health checks OK, no 5xx in first 2m.
Maya Patel: noticed a small tail in p95 for service-b-worker, ~12% increase. keeping an eye. If p95 > 20% or errors > 0.5% for 5m we should abort.
Alex Chen: noted, I'll enable extra tracing for worker paths. pinned rollout config to allow immediate rollback: `fallback: release/0.24.6` and `pin_percent: 10` for safety.
Ron Li: FYI I added a temporary routing override to direct 15% of traffic to the pinned fallback if health degrades. config: `route_policy: immediate-fallback-on-threshold`.
Samir: 10:05:23 — errors 0.2%, p95 up to 15%. still under threshold. continuing.
Maya Patel: 10:09:04 — spike to 22% p95 on worker, errors 0.6% over 1m window. I'm recommending rollback for service-b.
Alex Chen: agree with rollback. Rolling back canary to `release/0.24.6` for all canary instances. Will also pause the scheduled ramp.
DeployBot: Rollback initiated for tag `release/0.24.7-hotpatch` -> reverting to `release/0.24.6` on service-b (canary and paused ramp). Action by Alex Chen. ETA ~3m.
Samir: running `kubectl rollout restart deployment/service-b-canary -n prod` and `kubectl set image deployment/service-b service-b=redwood/service-b:0.24.6` to force fallback.
Maya Patel: monitoring now — p95 back to baseline within 90s, errors dropping. Good.
Ron Li: after rollback, we should pin traffic at 100% to v0.24.6 while we investigate the mem leak regression. Also capturing heap dumps from canary instances that ran 0.24.7.
Alex Chen: I'll open a postmortem/bug: https://tickets.internal/REDW-4821 with repro steps and attach heap dumps. Suggest we block re-deploy of 0.24.7 until QA validates a fix.
DeployBot: Rollback complete. `release/0.24.6` active for service-b in production. Rolling back scheduled ramps and clearing temporary route overrides.
Maya Patel: thumbs up. Moving to a short change-window note: we'll keep a ticket for followup and schedule a small deploy window tomorrow 11:00 UTC for attempted re-run after fixes.
Samir: adding alert to staging jobs to run longer memory soak for the next candidate.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone for quick response. Summary: hotpatch 0.24.7 attempted, canary triggered, performance regression observed, rollback executed, pinned fallback v0.24.6. Next: debug, new build, extended soak, then re-rollout behind canary.
DeployBot: Thread closed — rollback confirmed. If you need a full incident writeup, create REDW-4821 and tag #incidents.
